amendments: ROOT D1: raw RTP only, no core presentationTimeUs
ROOT D2: anchor earliest sample unaffected by decoder/backend waits; use core enqueue where callback can block
ROOT D4: off default until device receipts; auto and source_time qualify or fall back

requested.auto: qualified source-time pacing, fallback reason recorded

rtpTimestamp.source: raw RTP after byte-order conversion, before division; never synthetic

anchorUs: client monotonic reassembly enqueue where callback can block; callback ingress diagnostic only; ms quantization explicit
offsetRewarmRule: Slew limits only the APPLIED offset: clip the lower-envelope correction to elapsed-time credit (1000 us/s, 100 us/update, fractional residue carried); debt never triggers a reset by itself. Re-warm clock_mapping_unstable only for (1) lower-envelope movement from the oldest retained estimate within offsetWindowUs exceeding max(offsetDivergenceToleranceUs, 4*anchorResolutionUs), confirmed in the same direction by offsetDivergenceFrames consecutive forward raw offset samples; (2) post-slew correction backlog strictly above offsetBacklogLimitUs in one direction for strictly longer than offsetBacklogHoldUs; or (3) raw offset displacement from the pre-update applied offset strictly above offsetStepThresholdUs in the same direction for offsetStepFrames consecutive forward frames. All histories/counters clear on reset; a reset starts an epoch from the current observation, pending even for warmupFrames=1. Source discontinuities and explicit lifecycle resets remain immediate. Divergence estimate history excludes all warmup estimates and is seeded by the first valid steady estimate after warmup (observations > warmupFrames); raw offset history still fits startup normally.
